title: Hamsheer Shahe Deen ki Duniya se Jaarahi Hai___
body:
Hamsheer shahedeen ki duniya se jaarahi hai.
<<MINI>>
Zainab ka har musibat nouha sunarahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Hamsheer shahedeen ki duniya se jaarahi hai.
<<MINI>>
Zainab ka har musibat nouha sunarahi hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Zaalim ne belchey ka yunn waar kardiya hai.
Qudd mout bekasi par aansoo baharahi hai......
3.Guzri phupii jahan se tanha huwa bhatija.
Sajjad ki aseeri sabko rularahi hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Kunbe ki roone waali qamoosh hogayi hai.
Kiskis ka daagh lekar shahzadi jaarahi hai.
5.Har ek qadam qayamat har lamha thi musibat.
Lekar nashaa rasan ke bazoo pe jaarahi hai.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Beton ki laash par bhi rooyii nahi thi bibi.
Istarha bhai ka gham bibi manaa rahi hai.....
7.Beti Ali ki logo inn majlison se ab bhi.
Paigham shahe deen ka sab ko suna rahi hai....
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Aye murtuza kaho ab shahzadi Fatima bhi.
Beti ka pursa lene majlis may aarahii hai.....
Hamsheer shahe deen ki duniya se jaarahi hai...
Azz:- murtuza Ali meesum
